content.content:
We need list of Final Four teams for those years, plus mascot names. Provide JSON.

We need to ensure correct data.

Years:

2019 Final Four: 
- Virginia Cavaliers (University of Virginia) - mascot: Cavaliers (the team name is Cavaliers)
- Texas Tech Red Raiders (Texas Tech University) - mascot: Red Raiders
- Auburn Tigers (Auburn University) - mascot: Tigers
- Michigan State Spartans (Michigan State University) - mascot: Spartans

Check: 2019 champion Virginia, runner-up Texas Tech. Yes.

2021 Final Four (tournament held in 2021 after 2020 cancelled):
- Gonzaga Bulldogs (Gonzaga University) - Bulldogs
- Baylor Bears (Baylor University) - Bears
- UCLA Bruins (University of California, Los Angeles) - Bruins
- Houston Cougars (University of Houston) - Cougars

2022 Final Four:
- Kansas Jayhawks (University of Kansas) - Jayhawks
- North Carolina Tar Heels (University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill) - Tar Heels
- Villanova Wildcats (Villanova University) - Wildcats
- Duke Blue Devils (Duke University) - Blue Devils

2023 Final Four:
- UConn Huskies (University of Connecticut) - Huskies
- San Diego State Aztecs (San Diego State University) - Aztecs
- Miami Hurricanes (University of Miami) - Hurricanes
- Texas Longhorns (University of Texas at Austin) - Longhorns

We need to provide JSON array with entries per year.

Each entry: {"year": 2019, "teams": [ {"university": "...", "mascot": "..."} ... ] }

Make sure mascot corresponds to official nickname.

Provide answer.

No need for external lookup? Could verify. Might use search to confirm 2023 final four list.
